cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
This proxies to the unauthenticated port which will be removed in a future version. We would want this to be 8971 which will get complicated since the user may or may not have TLS enabled.

```suggestion
  proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8971/;
```
